description.value:
An energy-reinforced exoskeleton surrounds you, boosting your defenses. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

If you take 20 or more damage from a single hit while this effect is active, it detonates: all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-foot emanation} take 2d6 electricity damage (@Check[reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)|basic|options:me-power:me-tech-armor-detonation] save against your class DC) and this effect ends. This detonation can be triggered intentionally as a free action on your turn.
